quest.a_night_at_the_theatre.start: Mysterious Stranger, Ver Sinhaza, candidate tile 3673,3223,0.
quest.a_night_at_the_theatre.prerequisite: Completion of A Taste of Hope gives access to the investigation.
quest.a_night_at_the_theatre.route: Crypt investigation, araxyte/spider cave, Sisterhood Sanctuary and Daer Krand, delivery of spider eggs, Nature Grotto mutated Hespori encounter and bark harvest, then an Entry Mode Theatre of Blood clear and final Mysterious Stranger dialogue. Six individual Theatre encounters are conditionally successful: Maiden, Bloat, Nylocas, Sotetseg, Xarpus and Verzik.
quest.a_night_at_the_theatre.required_equipment: Either of the existing Ivandis and blisterwood flails, a saw, a ghostspeak amulet and an axe. The starter bronze axe is sufficient. Raid supplies, food, party composition and retry costs remain estimates.
quest.a_night_at_the_theatre.completion: 2 quest points, four held 20,000 XP lamps: each player choice restricted to Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic or Hitpoints with at least 50 base levels. Item choice must be actively redeemed later.

quest.the_heart_of_darkness.start: Itzla at Teomat (1454,3173,0), after Twilight's Promise.
quest.the_heart_of_darkness.requirements: 55 Mining, 48 Thieving, 48 Slayer, 46 Agility, each nonboostable in the pinned helper.
quest.the_heart_of_darkness.route: Sunset Coast bartender and prince interviews, repair Salvager Overlook landing, recruit the Ascended, four linked palace trials (pickpocket and poem, combat, clue-based accusations, prince duel), recover Emissary robes, attend temple service, enter frozen ruins, mine passages with a locally found pickaxe, navigate levers/ledges, collect and place four elemental urns, read the four markings, solve statue sequence, defeat Amoxliatl, report to Servius.
quest.the_heart_of_darkness.materials: Quest-bound first-trial key, poem notes and robes. Frozen-ruin pickaxe is obtainable in the quest area; four urns are collected and consumed at the four matching statues. Source states contain no authoritative cost for the shops or landing-site repair; the current draft does not invent spending.
quest.the_heart_of_darkness.completion: 2 quest points, 8,000 XP in Mining, Thieving, Slayer and Agility, with no arbitrary combat XP inserted.
